meta.title: ブルージュ美食ガイド
meta.sub: 運河と中世の家並みが世界遺産の「北のヴェネツィア」。北海の灰色小エビのコロッケ（ガルナール・クロケット）、ビールで煮込む牛肉の郷土料理ストーフフレース、市内醸造所のビール、チョコレート、ワッフルとフリッツまで、乳児連れの1泊2日で回れる厳選37スポット。各店に営業時間・定休日・予約・乳児連れ情報・味の証拠・参照元・Googleマップリンク付き。
meta.tips: 旧市街は東西1.5km・徒歩で回れるが石畳が多いのでベビーカーは大径タイヤかキャリアが楽。土曜午前はマルクト広場と't Zand の朝市、日曜は旧市街の多くのチョコレート店・ワッフル店が開く一方、郷土料理店は月・火休みが多い。ランチは12時前に入ると待たずに済む。市内の醸造所 De Halve Maan は見学が人気なので予約を。5月はアスパラガス（witte asperges）の旬。

review_texts.text: After eating waffles for several days, I appreciated that Otto's waffles weren't as heavy or dense. The texture was light and not quite as sweet. I went minimal with my toppings and chose the yogurt with honey and cinnamon. Not only was it delicious, but I didn't feel nearly as guilty for eating this treat.
The only drawback is that the featured waffles with several toppings are expensive, priced at €9. The plain waffle dusted with coconut blossom sugar is €4, which is average.

Gluten-free oat waffles resembling Bruges lace, sprinkled with coconut blossom sugar... From sour cream with honey over pomegranate to home-made caramel sauce and lemon zest. By the way, they had the waffle irons custom made. As soon as you step in, you feel welcome.

House of Waffles always makes your waffle fresh. This makes a world of difference. Many waffle shops will constantly make waffles and then pile them up so they can immediately serve customers.

stores.reason: Abroad with Ash（2025年更新）が「ブルージュで最高のプレーン・リエージュワッフルの一つ（焼きたてなら）」と特別賞に選出。マルクト至近で行列が絶えない人気店。

stores.taste_quote: 「These are some of the best plain Liege waffles in Bruges.」「So, when the waffles are fresh they are fantastic.」
stores.taste_quote_src: https://www.abroadwithash.com/best-waffles-in-bruges-belgium/（旅行ブログ Abroad with Ash／2025年8月更新）

review_texts.text: When there's a line, which is almost always, the waffles are good. This is because they're serving waffles so fast they haven't had a moment to sit. When there is no line, ask for a fresh waffle.
Plain waffles are €3.30, with chocolate or whipped cream €4.50, strawberries and chocolate €7.10.
Great experience. Waffles were made to order, tasted incredible and the person behind the counter was so friendly and patient. The waffles were sweet but not overly so.

stores.desc: シェフ2人が営むフリッツ専門のイートイン店。100%ベルギー産じゃがいもの二度揚げフリッツに自家製ソースや変わり種トッピングをのせ、地元風味のクロケットも揃う。テーブルサービスで座って食べられる。
stores.sig: ローデッド・フリッツ（ベルギー式フリッツにトリュフマヨや煮込み肉などをのせた一皿）／クロケット（地元風味の自家製コロッケ）
stores.hours: 月〜日 12:00〜21:00（公式サイト。キッチン通し営業）
stores.reason: 宿泊施設 YouStay の「ブルージュのベストフリッツ」、地元ガイド Best of Bruges（2025年版）で掲載。口コミ件数も多いが、専門媒体の味の評価は未取得。
stores.taste_quote: 「Reviewers rave about the friendly service, delicious Farmer Sausage, perfectly cooked Belgian fries with Truffle Mayonnaise, unique croquettes like Squirt and Drunken Pig Croquet」

review_texts.text: Reviewers rave about the friendly service, delicious Farmer Sausage, perfectly cooked Belgian fries with Truffle Mayonnaise, unique croquettes like Squirt and Drunken Pig Croquet, and generous portions. While some were disappointed by small portions or lackluster dishes like plain burgers or tiny meatballs without advertised ingredients...

Here you can not only eat fries, but experience an incredible taste explosion. In addition to Belgian fries, you choose your own extraordinary topping. You can also enjoy a lot of delicious croquettes here.

stores.notes: 公式「We do NOT take reservations」。ヴィーガン・グルテンフリーのトッピングあり。Wix画像は変換パラメータを外した原本URL（存在・サイズ確認済み）。

stores.yomi: フリトゥール・デ・ヘントポールト
stores.short: シェフ推薦のフリッツ店
stores.desc: 中世の城門ヘントポールト近くにある家族経営のフリットコット（フリッツ店）。植物油で揚げるカリッとしたフリッツが評判で、持ち帰り専用。電話・オンラインで事前注文すれば待たずに受け取れ、門の脇の運河沿いで食べられる。
stores.sig: フリッツ＋ストーフフレースソース（二度揚げのベルギー式フライドポテトに、牛肉のビール煮込みのソースをかけた定番の食べ方）
stores.reason: Visit Bruges「Flavourite Bruges」で地元シェフ Patrick Devos が推薦。宿泊施設 YouStay の「ベストフリッツ」、Best of Bruges 2025年版にも掲載。

sources.label: Visit Bruges Flavourite Bruges（シェフ Patrick Devos 推薦）

stores.taste_quote: 「Ordered the groot size Belgian fries with the andalouse sauce. They were nice and crisp and delicious with the sauce.」
stores.taste_quote_src: https://www.frituurdegentpoorte.be/contact/（公式サイトに掲載された客のレビュー・Jeremy B.。店が選んだ転載である点に注意）
stores.status_evidence: 公式サイト（2026年9月閲覧）に「9月24〜27日臨時休業、10月1日（木）から再開」の告知 → 営業中。

review_texts.text: Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. We stopped in for a snack while visiting Bruges in October... Ordered the groot size Belgian fries with the andalouse sauce. They were nice and crisp and delicious with the sauce.
The best french fries in the town. Prices are reasonable, portions are huge. The employees are so kind.
My mum always had a chip shop and as a kid I ate loads of fries, up to five times a day. I never made French fries for our children, but when we passed by De Gentpoorte a few years ago, I gave in.

stores.notes: 店内飲食不可（持ち帰りのみ）。月〜水定休のため、土日訪問には問題なし。g[2] は外観。

status_evidence.date: 2025-07（Visit Bruges：2025年7月にJulius Chocolate Barを開店と記載）／公式サイトに2026年コレクション画像（2026-praline-bloody-hands等）あり（2026-09-25確認）

review_texts.text: Since they do bean to bar chocolates, when you bite into one of their pralines you don't just taste the high quality filling, but you taste the cocoa solids and fats in the chocolate, and the creaminess of the milk. ... Their chocolates are about the same price as the other Bruges chocolatiers on this list. However, their flavor combinations are some of the most creative, and the execution is undoubtedly the best.

Locals and tourists alike flock here to taste the gastronomique varieties (pricey at about €8.40/100 grams) concocted by Dominique Persoone ... Even those that sound gross can be surprisingly good: Havana cigar (marinated in rum, cognac, and Cuban tobacco leaves), Saké (bitter ganache, seaweed, and Japanese rice wine)...
The one with the cherry was over the top and the walnut excellent, but I was surprised by the biscuit. ... Nevertheless, I rated each well above all the other chocolates I had ever tasted.

stores.name: Chocolatier Dumon (Eiermarkt)
stores.yomi: ショコラティエ・デュモン
stores.short: 絵になる家族経営の人気店
stores.desc: 1992年創業の家族経営ショコラティエ。マルクト広場裏エイエルマルクトの小さな古い家の店は「ブルージュで最も写真に撮られる店」の一つ。昔ながらのレシピの生クリーム系プラリネが中心で、マリア通り14番地にも新店舗。
stores.sig: プラリネ（一口チョコ）の詰め合わせ。特にキャラメルや、種入りチェリーのリキュール漬けチョコ（チョコ殻にサクランボと酒を閉じ込めた一粒）が評判
stores.reason: Rick Stevesが「ブルージュで最もなめらかでクリーミー」、NeverStopTravelingは食べ歩きの末「街で最高」と評価。Dame Cacaoは「話題ほどではない」と辛口。

sources.label: 公式サイト（店舗・営業時間）

stores.taste_quote: 「The caramel almost made my tongue melt. The cherry ("be careful, it still has the stone inside") was bursting with a delicious cherry liqueur.」
stores.taste_quote_src: NeverStopTraveling（旅行ブログ） https://www.neverstoptraveling.com/chocolate-in-bruges
stores.taste_note: Dame Cacaoは「fine... nothing special」と辛口評価もあり

status_evidence.date: 公式店舗ページに2026-01-10付ファイル名の新店（Mariastraat 14）写真、フッター©2026（2026-09-25確認）

review_texts.text: Some of Bruges' smoothest, creamiest chocolates are at Dumon. Try a small mix-and-match box to sample a few out-of-this-world flavors, and come back for more of your favorites.

The chocolates are quite creamy and filled with classic crèmes, caramel and fruit flavors. My box of 12 pieces was a nice mix and surprisingly very affordable (under 10 euro) as were the prices of prepackaged options on the shelves.
The chocolates themselves are fine, with the sweet milk chocolate hitting me best, but nothing special; I really don't get the hype.
The caramel almost made my tongue melt. The cherry was bursting with a delicious cherry liqueur. The walnut and all the others were superb.

stores.taste_quote: 「Pol Depla, lid van de Gilde van de Brugse Chocolatiers, kiest resoluut voor klassieke pralines: verfijnd, verzorgd en aangenaam uitgebalanceerd, zonder overdreven zoetheid.」
stores.taste_quote_src: Gault&Millau Belgium 評 https://www.gaultmillau.be/nl/chocolatiers/depla-chocolatier-brugge

review_texts.text: (English translation of Gault&Millau Belgium) Pol Depla, a member of the Guild of Bruges Chocolatiers, resolutely opts for classic pralines: refined, well-crafted and pleasantly balanced, without excessive sweetness.

While I'd recommend stopping into their official shop if you have a strong preference for any particular flavors, their waffle shop outlet has a perfectly good selection, and even uses their chocolate in their waffle topping. Overall, their flavor selection is decent, but neither the best nor the worst in town.

stores.name: Chocolaterie Sukerbuyc
stores.yomi: ショコラトリー・スケルバイク
stores.short: G&M掲載の三代目老舗
stores.desc: 1977年創業の家族経営チョコ店で現在は三代目。カテリネ通りの赤い日よけが目印で、窓越しに工房も覗ける。向かいの英国風ティールーム「De Proeverie」で自家製プラリネやホットチョコを味わえる。
stores.sig: プラリネ（一口チョコ）。柚子・カラマンシー・フルール・ド・セル（塩）など現代的な味と、洗練された定番の両方
stores.reason: G&M Belgiumが三代目の刷新で「定番がさらに洗練され優雅に」と評価、Visit Brugesは「ブルージュの基準点」と紹介。NeverStopTravelingは大衆向けと辛口。
stores.taste_quote: 「Zo kregen tal van pralines met onder meer yuzu, kalamansi of fleur de sel een eigentijds smaakprofiel, terwijl het klassieke repertoire nog aan verfijning, nuance en elegantie won.」
stores.taste_quote_src: Gault&Millau Belgium 評 https://www.gaultmillau.be/nl/chocolatiers/chocolaterie-sukerbuyc-brugge

status_evidence.date: Visit Bruges掲載写真のファイル名が260402（2026-04-02撮影）。公式サイト Copyright 2025（2026-09-25確認）

review_texts.text: (English translation of Gault&Millau Belgium) Many pralines, with yuzu, calamansi or fleur de sel among others, were given a contemporary flavour profile, while the classic repertoire gained even more refinement, nuance and elegance.

Ditto for Daya Chocolates, Sukerbuyc Chocolaterie, Verheecke, Brown & Sugar and Moeder Babelutte. Unfortunately, they all seemed to be targeting the mass market, rather than concentrating their efforts on producing the sublime chocolates I sought.

stores.name: The Old Chocolate House

stores.short: ホットチョコの喫茶室

stores.sig: ホットチョコレート（熱い牛乳に好みのチョコのペレットを入れて自分で溶かす飲み物）とワッフル

stores.taste_quote: 「Not only is the Old Chocolate House a chocolate shop, it is also a tea room where you can taste the sweets directly. Their hot chocolate is simply delicious.」
stores.taste_quote_src: Destination(s) Europe（旅行ブログ） https://destinations-europe.com/en/the-three-best-chocolate-shops-in-bruges/
stores.taste_note: プラリネはDame Cacaoが「very sweet and flat」と否定的。飲み物目当てが無難

status_evidence.date: 公式サイト ©2026 表記・営業時間掲載（2026-09-25確認）。Visit Bruges掲載画像は2025-01-07加工

review_texts.text: The tearoom is not so much about tea as about hot chocolate: You can choose from about 20 varieties. Even locals come her to savor some of the best hot chocolate around (they have waffles, too). Pralines cost about €4.40/100 grams.
Their hot chocolate is simply delicious. Plus, you get to choose the type of chocolate from which you want yours to be made.
But of the four bonbons I bought, I only finished one; everything was very sweet and flat, with each flavor falling short of expectations. ... The hot chocolate smelled good, though.

stores.name: Brouwerij De Halve Maan
stores.yomi: ブラウウェライ・デ・ハルヴェ・マーン
stores.short: 市内唯一の老舗醸造所

review_texts.text: Bierbrasserie Cambrinus draws in the crowds for the simplest of reasons: it serves very good beer alongside very good food, in an unpretentious setting with a large and occasionally daunting beer list. ... Good value, reliably excellent.

The beef stew (called Flemish Carbonades on the menu) was cooked in their beer and unlike stews I am used to was not mixed with potatoes and carrots. The beef was served in a gravy with applesauce and fried potato croquettes came in a bowl on the side.
Prices were reasonable (about 17 Euros for each of our dishes) and the beer's ranged in prices, but hers were about 3.5 Euros each
Cambrinus is the city’s beer hall without the tourist tax.

review_texts.text: It sits down a quiet side street in the Sint-Anna district, well away from the main tourist circuit, and it looks exactly as it should: heavy wooden beams overhead, old portraits and engravings on the walls, a black marble fireplace, antique furniture and the kind of unhurried atmosphere that takes centuries to accumulate.

The panelled rooms lead to a leafy courtyard that begs for a relaxed afternoon with a witbier or a malty ale and a simple snack.

review_texts.text: Rose Red is everything an intrepid beer traveler could want: an extensive beer list, knowledgeable staff, food several notches above average, and a dimly lit space with a touch of elegance that recalls De Garre.
That was until the menu piqued our interest: Belgian classics, but also food with an international flair. Picanha prepared in the style of vitello tonnato. Pan con sobrasada. Gyoza.

Now serving (very good) food, it can get incredibly busy, so reservations are recommended. It's still ok to come in just for a beer, space permitting, but it definitely feels like the focus has shifted a bit more to food than beer.

review_texts.text: Also handy when you're with children, Zilverpand is closed to traffic, so they can run around. There are plenty of child-friendly dishes too.
In the morning, enjoy breakfast on their lovely terrace or a light lunch. It's great fun to do this with the children.

A nostalgic atmosphere, a cosy courtyard and all-day breakfast. ... Enjoy breakfast all day long with yoghurt bowls, American pancakes and soft-boiled eggs, or would you rather opt for the brunch board? ... Kids can play in the traffic-free courtyard.

review_texts.text: The sleek Norwegian interior, the covered terrace and the half-open kitchen are a few of the reasons why Nomad convinced us.

Nomad focusses on inspired, original world food which tastes great at any time of the day, serving a selection of stylish, healthy dishes. Home grown organic vegetables one day on their farm, and the next on your plate.

review_texts.text: Tanuki is a little slice of Japan in the middle of Bruges. In its open kitchen Ivan juggles with sushi and sashimi and seven-course meals are steamed in a quiet and serene setting.

(英訳) Even after more than 35 years, chef Ivan Verhelle and sous-chef Akihisa Kawakami impress with their Japanese cuisine. Sashimi is cut according to the rules of the art and is a feast for the eye. Freshness is paramount, as is the basic quality of all products.
Only Japanese is spoken in the open kitchen. Tanuki is a little piece of Japan in the heart of the city.

review_texts.text: Love Eat Share Smile is the baseline of this hip urban eatery, which is equally suited to a hunger-obliterating snack at the bar as to a full-course feast with all the trimmings with all the family. You can expect an international culinary repertory with a definite Asian slant.
(英訳) Culinary tapas bar with a mix of Spanish accents and powerful flavours from the Far East and Central America. It is a popular hotspot, so do book ahead!
Top-level gastronomy with décor ranging from New York to Tokyo, right on 't Zand. Don't forget to book in advance.

review_texts.text: (英訳) I love sharing food, and at the idyllic restaurant Atelier Flori I'm in exactly the right place. The concept? You order tiered stands with all sorts of tasty plant-based bites – from Italian arancini and soups to colourful salads and nachos – to enjoy together.
